from solution import error_summary as f
assert f('TIMEOUT,AUTH,IO') == 'permanent=1;transient=2'
assert f('AUTH,BAD_INPUT') == 'permanent=2;transient=0'
assert f('TIMEOUT') == 'permanent=0;transient=1'
assert f('AUTH,OTHER') == None
assert f('') == None
assert f('AUTH,') == None
